WITH total_races AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM races
),
circuit_race_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    r.circuitId,
    AVG(r.round) as avg_round,
    COUNT(*) as race_count,
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total FROM total_races) as share
  FROM races r
  GROUP BY r.circuitId
),
tenth_highest_share AS (
  SELECT share FROM circuit_race_stats
  ORDER BY share DESC
  LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9
)
SELECT 
  crs.circuitId,
  c.name as circuit_name,
  ROUND(crs.avg_round, 2) as avg_round,
  crs.race_count,
  ROUND(crs.share, 4) as share
FROM circuit_race_stats crs
LEFT JOIN circuits c ON crs.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE crs.share >= (SELECT share FROM tenth_highest_share)
ORDER BY crs.share DESC    -- Returns 11 rows: Monza (6.82%), Monaco (6.52%), Silverstone (5.22%), Spa (5.12%), Nürburgring (4.01%), Gilles Villeneuve (3.91%), Hockenheimring (3.61%), Autódromo José Carlos Pace (3.61%), Hungaroring (3.31%), Suzuka (3.01%), and Zandvoort (3.01% tied at 10th)
